text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
—Food, check. Drinks, check.
Blankets... check.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Recharge Day. Please refrain from visiting."
Sign on the door, check. All that's left is—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu & Mirako
text_block_list.text: Doing absolutely nothing!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: The sound of the river... is so soothing~.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: ...It really is. The birds chirping and the rustling trees... feel so nice.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: I want to go to an open-air bath in a place like this. Surrounded by the scent of nature, relaxing with not a care in the world—
(*Grumble~~~~*)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ah... My stomach growled.
I'm getting a little hungry... What about you, Dantsu-chan?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Fufu, me too.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: ...But what should we eat? I don't really have the energy to eat a full meal yet...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: I hear ya~. Maybe for today, I'll just settle for snacking on some treats.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu, that sounds good. I'll do that too.

text_block_list.name: Energetic Horse Girl
text_block_list.text: —What are you doing? Hurry up and get to the training track!

text_block_list.name: Laid-back Horse Girl
text_block_list.text: Ah~ wait for me~. I forgot my training notebook in the room~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...Everyone's heading out to train today, huh~.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: The weather is nice, after all. The training track must be pretty crowded~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: I was... trying my best in my own way with training this week too, but... My times actually ended up dropping instead~.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Same here... The harder I try, the worse they get—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...Realistically, times like this are when we ought to push ourselves even harder, I guess.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Lazing around in pajamas while everyone else works hard. Haah... Koo-chan is a bad girl.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: ...If that's the case, I'm a bad girl too. Skipping proper meals and lazing around in pajamas...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: But you know... when hard work doesn't pay off, it really takes a toll on you in its own way.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: If we don't heal up first, we won't even be able to run properly anyway~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: We work reasonably hard every day, so divine punishment won't strike us for this, right?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: ...It won't strike us. You're doing your best, Mirako-senpai.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Fufu, you think so~? ...Well then, that means Dantsu-chan is even more safe.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: You work waaaay harder than me. If punishment struck you, that'd be a miracle in reverse.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu. Then it looks like both of us are going to be fine.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu & Mirako
text_block_list.text:
—Starting tomorrow, let's give it our all again.
—Starting tomorrow, let's try our best again.
One day, while preparing for training at the training track...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! That's amazing, Dantsu-chan!
You easily beat your personal best!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Wait, really?!
...Yay! That thing was super effective!
choice_data_list: Did you do some kind of special training?
Did you do some kind of special training?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Wait, really?!
...Yay! That thing was super effective!
choice_data_list: Did you do some kind of special training?
Did you do some kind of special training?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Ehehe!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Fufu. Hey Dantsu-chan, isn't it time for Reward Day next?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: ! You're right! Let's plan it out while we stretch!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu & Mirako
text_block_list.text: Special training...?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. Nothing like that in particular...
If I had to say, maybe something like "giving our all at not pushing ourselves"?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Like "not pushing ourselves so we can give our all"? Or maybe "not pushing ourselves because we want to give our all"?
Hmm???
